Ceramic Tile. This stunning wall tile has a cool white, satin-looking color with indented texture that plays off of the light in the room just enough to carry the eye all over it and create a truly interesting look. This tile comes in a 12x24 size, making for a quick installation and fewer grout line breaks, giving your space even more of an elegant feel. metadata.description: Adello Viso White Ceramic tile is a textured satin finish pure white porcelain tile that adds dimension, light, and shadow to kitchen backsplashes and walls.
